notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI's minimap cluster (Program.Minimap.cs) carries the reference chrome and most behaviors: UI-Minimap-Border top band + round border, zone text, minimap show/hide toggle button that keeps the chrome alive, zoom in/out buttons plus wheel zoom, aura-driven tracking icon in MiniMap-TrackingBorder with right-click cancel, unread-mail icon (INV_Letter_15 + tracking border) off the pending-mail flag, party dots, tracked-resource dots, and the player arrow. Several reference polish laws are absent.
